verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events, and suggests hypotheses about the cause, so the telemetry-correlation core is covered. The evidence only shows it being invoked on request (tagging @betterstack, calling it from Slack or Teams), not starting on its own when an incident fires. missing for 10: evidence of autonomous investigation before a human asks, correlation with recent changes or deploys, matching against similar past incidents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
Discussing an incident in Slack? Call the AI SRE simply by tagging @betterstack.
